'''System diagnosis packages''' were standard equipment in [[EG-6 power droid/Legends|EG-6 power droid]]. The package included a number of [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] including [[infrared receptor]]s, [[X-ray/Legends|X-ray]] sensors, and [[Spectrometer/Legends|spectrometers]].<ref name="CFTD">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref>
